name: Institute of Arcane Study
description: Wizards' institute on the mountain at the center of the valley.

description_citations.text: "The Prodigal Sorcerer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tagard, Talli and Karelon climb to the Institute to seek a wizard's aid, and Tagard convinces Alligarius Timni to join him.
timeline.quote: Tagard now convinces Alligarius Timni to accompany him to defeat Berimish

citation.text: "The Prodigal Sorcerer", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tagard Tarngold climbs the central mountain to petition the Institute of Arcane Study, and Aligarius Timni agrees to help.
timeline.quote: he climbed the mountain at the center of the valley to petition the Institute of Arcane Study for aid

citation.text: "Betrayal of Tamingazin", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Free of brainwashing, Aligarius returns to the Institute, humbled.
timeline.quote: Aligarius returned to the Institute of Arcane Study, profoundly humbled by his role in nearly destroying the Valley.

citation.text: "Aligarius Timni", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Refugees from the destroyed College of Lat-Nam found the Institute and later erect the Magewall.
